output.why: Increasing the MRS Unit-1 pump capacity to 20 m3/h keeps the velocity in the 65 NB discharge line (~1.67 m/s) and the 80 NB common header to TP-18 (~1.66 m/s combined with Unit-2's 10 m3/h) within the 2.4 m/s limit on Part5.pdf p.200. However, the downstream receiving capacity at CHP TP-18 is not detailed in this specification and must be verified to accept the increased flow.
